capability.description:
Value of the permission. Most permission types only use the default set of
values, but a few (like 'https-only-load-insecure') also use other values.
capability.title: Value

filter_expression.description:
A JEXL to filter records. See
https://remote-settings.readthedocs.io/en/latest/target-filters.html#how
filter_expression.title: Filter Expression

origin.description:
Origin for which this permission should be set. For example https://example.com.
Does not need to include OA, as permissions will be set for both normal and
private browsing automatically.
origin.title: Origin

type.description:
Type of the permission. For example 'cookie', 'geo' or
'https-only-load-insecure'.
type.title: Type
